Name: Community Center Reimagined (zh translation)
Author: feikuang
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Chinese Translation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966]Community Center Reimagined[/url][/b]
This mod provides a Simplified Chinese translation.
It includes Chinese translations for the mod's dialogue, events, NPC interactions, Community Center content, school lessons, rainy-day activities, and other related text.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966]Community Center Reimagined[/url][/b] 的简体中文翻译。 [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]本 Mod 为《Community Center Reimagined》提供简体中文翻译。 [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]翻译内容包括 Mod 中的对话、事件、NPC 互动、社区中心内容、学校课程、雨天活动以及其他相关文本。 [/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the original mod.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]安装原 Mod。  [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Download and extract this translation. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]下载并解压本中文翻译。  [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Copy the translation files into the original mod's folder, replacing the corresponding files when prompted.[/color]
将翻译文件复制到原 Mod 的文件夹中。如果系统提示替换对应文件，请选择替换。



[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Simplified Chinese translation [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]简体中文翻译[/color]
